result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred or fallback position because it permits HDI's General Manager to conduct the inspection; the playbook requires an independent auditor bound by confidentiality. The frequency, notice, business-hours, cost, confidentiality, and no-system-access protections otherwise meet or exceed the preferred position. However, prohibiting all access to facilities and requiring review only of copies, potentially off-site, goes beyond the stated no-direct-system-access requirement. The payment-record scope and other unrelated commercial terms are preserved, but the drafting should designate only an independent auditor and avoid unnecessary restrictions.
